387377: Young Spartans Exercising, also known as Young Spartans and as Young Spartan Girls Challenging Boys, is an early oil on canvas painting by French impressionist artist Edgar Degas. The work depicts two groups of male and female Spartan youth exercising and challenging each other in some way.
1016012: Ludovic Lepic and His Daughters is an oil painting on canvas completed ca. 1871 by the French artist Edgar Degas. The painting depicts Ludovic-Napoléon Lepic with his young daughters, Eylau and Jeanine.
1239950: L'Absinthe is a painting by Edgar Degas, painted between 1875 and 1876. Its original title was Dans un Café, a name often used today.
1565086: Les Choristes is an 1877 pastel on monotype by French artist Edgar Degas.
2622172: The Bellelli Family, also known as Family Portrait, is an oil painting on canvas by Edgar Degas (1834–1917), painted c. 1858–1867, It is housed in the Musée d'Orsay, in Paris. A masterwork of Degas' youth, it is a portrait of his aunt, her husband, and their two young daughters.
2734209: The Little Fourteen-Year-Old Dancer is a sculpture begun c. 1880 by Edgar Degas of a young student of the Paris Opera Ballet dance school, a Belgian named Marie van Goethem.
2912117: The Tub is an 1886 pastel drawing on heavy wove paper by the French artist Edgar Degas. The work depicts a nude woman crouched in a shallow tub, illuminated by early morning light as she bathes.
3220733: Café-Concert at Les Ambassadeurs is a monotype pastel by Edgar Degas of the cafe-concert at the Café des Ambassadeurs café-concert. It was first exhibited in 1877 at an Impressionist exhibition and is now in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon.
3633414: Ballerina Posing for a Photographer is an oil on canvas painting executed in 1875 by the French artist Edgar Degas.
3633419: Blue Dancers is a c. 1898 pastel by Edgar Degas. It is held in the Pushkin Museum, in Moscow, which it entered in 1948 from the State Museum of Modern Western Art.
3660765: At the Races in the Countryside or Carriage at the Races is an oil on canvas painting by the French painter Edgar Degas, from 1869. The painting, which depicts a scene of a family in a horse-drawn carriage in the countryside, is on display at the Museum of Fine Arts Boston.
At the Races in the Countryside
3794019: Dance Class at the Opera is an oil on canvas painting by Edgar Degas from c. 1872. It measures 32.7 by 46.3 cm.
3794660: A Cotton Office in New Orleans, also known as Interior of an Office of Cotton Buyers in New Orleans and Portraits in an Office (New Orleans), is an oil painting by Edgar Degas. Degas depicts the interior of his maternal uncle Michel Musson's cotton firm in New Orleans.
A Cotton Office in New Orleans
3819661: The Orchestra at the Opera is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist Edgar Degas, from c. 1870. It is held at the Musée d'Orsay in Paris.
3821820: The Ballet Class is an oil painting on canvas created between 1874 and 1876 by the French artist Edgar Degas. The painting depicts a group of ballet dancers at the end of a lesson, led by ballet master Jules Perrot.
3837030: Lorenzo Pagans and Auguste de Gas is the title of a painting by Edgar Degas. Painted in oil on canvas, it is 54.5 cm high and 39.5 cm wide.
Lorenzo Pagans and Auguste de Gas
3842349: Miss La La at the Cirque Fernando is an oil on canvas painting by the French Impressionist artist Edgar Degas. Painted in 1879 and exhibited at the Fourth Impressionist Exhibition in Paris that same year, it is now in the collection of the National Gallery in London.
Miss La La at the Cirque Fernando
3874376: The Millinery Shop is an oil on canvas painting by the French Impressionist artist Edgar Degas created between 1879 and 1886. It illustrates a young woman, perhaps a hat-maker or a shop customer, seated at a table examining a hat in her hands and additional hats on wooden stands.
3937379: Portraits at the Stock Exchange is a painting by the French artist Edgar Degas. Completed in about 1879, the painting was already in the collection of the French banker Ernest May when it was listed in the catalogue of the fourth Impressionist exhibition that year.
4880363: Before the Race is an oil on panel painting by French Impressionist painter Edgar Degas, from 1882-1884. He had began painting scenes with horses in the 1860s.
6046671: Interior, also known as The Rape, is an oil painting on canvas by Edgar Degas (1834–1917), painted in 1868–1869. Described as "the most puzzling of Degas's major works", it depicts a tense confrontation by lamplight between a man and a partially undressed woman.
7200240: Place de la Concorde or Viscount Lepic and his Daughters Crossing the Place de la Concorde is an 1875 oil painting by Edgar Degas. It depicts the cigar-smoking Ludovic-Napoléon Lepic, his daughters Eylau and Jeanine, his dog, and a solitary man on the left at Place de la Concorde in Paris.
7476471: The Dancing Class is an oil painting on wood executed around 1870 by the French artist Edgar Degas. The painting depicts a dancing class at the Paris Opéra.
7960534: Waiting is a pastel on paper by the French Impressionist Edgar Degas, completed between 1880-882.
11451054: Young Woman in Blue is a drawing by French artist Edgar Degas, created in 1884. It is currently in the permanent collection at the Indianapolis Museum of Art.
15727864: The Dance Lesson is an oil on canvas painting by the French artist Edgar Degas created c. 1879. It is held at the National Gallery of Art in Washington, D.C. There is at least one other work by Degas by this title, also made in about 1879, which is a pastel.
17510059: After the Bath, Woman Drying Herself is a pastel drawing by Edgar Degas, made between 1890 and 1895. Since 1959, it has been in the collection of the National Gallery, London.
After the Bath, Woman Drying Herself
18611118: Dancers Onstage is an oil on canvas painting by French artist Edgar Degas, from 1889. It is held in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon.
18758802: The Dance Class is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist Edgar Degas, from 1874. It is in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art, in New York.
The Dance Class (Degas, Metropolitan Museum of Art)
19911849: The Collector of Prints is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French Impressionist artist Edgar Degas. The painting, which was produced in 1866, depicts an unknown male subject sitting down, pausing while browsing through a portfolio of prints and meeting the viewer's gaze.
20188683: Scene from the Steeplechase: The Fallen Jockey is an 1866 oil-on-canvas painting by Edgar Degas. Degas reworked the painting on multiple occasions, once in 1880–81, and again in 1897.
Scene from the Steeplechase: The Fallen Jockey
52216851: Singer with a Glove by Edgar Degas, originally titled Chanteuse de Café, la chanteuse au gant, is an 1878 pastel drawing on canvas 53.2 x 41 cm. Degas was a French artist known for his pastels, paintings, sculptures, prints, and charcoal drawings.
80989450: Jockeys Before the Race is an oil on canvas genre painting by the French artist Edgar Degas, from 1879. It shows the moment before the start of a race as the racehorses and jockeys mill about.
96953521: Woman in a Tub is one of a suite of pastels on paper created by the French painter Edgar Degas in the 1880s and is in the collection of the Hill-Stead Museum in Connecticut.
111962908: Ukrainian Dancers is a theme series of pastels by Edgar Degas depicting Ukrainian women performing folk dances. Degas created these drawings during the 1890s and early 1900s.
